vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes bypass the release-age wait and the PR concurrency limit, so a red audit never sits blocked behind routine dependency PRs.

packageRules.description: Automerge patch/minor updates, digest bumps, and lockfile maintenance when CI passes. Major bumps still require manual review.
Backend stack is standardized on PHP 8.4. Do not bump Docker images or Composer platform to PHP 8.5/8.6.
